scenarios.name: No requests
assumptions: One sequential request per instance; request durations treated as constant averages rounded up to 100 ms
Startup and graceful shutdown are billable and modeled separately
No warm idle instances (minimum instances 0); no startup CPU boost
These are workload assumptions, not measured inference latency
Shared free credits cannot be claimed independently for every scenario/service/project
Excluded services, tax and data transfer are additional; budget alerts and maximum instances 1 are not a spending cap
